cnTitle: 盘的整体布局怎么看：先看骨架再填血肉
enTitle: How to Read the Overall Layout of a Zi Wei Chart
enDesc: For the overall layout of a chart, first read the skeleton of the Life Palace triple-direction, then fill in the details of stars and transformations, and finally layer the decade and year. The layout reads where the power flows, not the good or bad of one palace.
cnDesc: 一张盘的整体布局，先看命宫三方四正的骨架结构，再填星曜四化的血肉细节，最后叠大限流年；布局读的是力量往哪个方向走，不是单宫吉凶。

cnTitle: 四正宫怎么照：本宫与对宫是一条直线上的呼应
enTitle: How the Four-Direction Palaces Work in a Zi Wei Chart
enDesc: The four-direction means the home palace, the opposite palace and two trine palaces forming a complete view. The home palace is the core, the opposite supplements along a straight line, and the two trines supply from the side; all four together read fully.
cnDesc: 四正指本宫、对宫及两个三合宫构成的完整视野；本宫写核心，对宫是一条直线上的补充，两个三合宫从侧面供给，四宫合看才读得全。

cnTitle: 夹宫怎么看：左右两宫夹住本宫，夹吉助吉夹煞助煞
enTitle: How to Read the Flanking Palaces in a Zi Wei Chart
enDesc: The flanking palaces are the two adjacent palaces, such as Parents and Siblings around the Life Palace. Auspicious flanks bring close support, malefic flanks bring close pressure; flanks read the nearest external forces.
cnDesc: 夹宫指本宫左右相邻两宫，如命宫的父母宫与兄弟宫；夹吉则助力贴身，夹煞则压力贴身，夹宫看的是身边最近的外部力量。

cnTitle: 星曜庙旺落陷怎么判断：亮度决定这股劲有没有力气
enTitle: How to Judge Star Brightness: Temple, Prosperous and Fallen
enDesc: Brightness is the state of a star across branches, deciding whether the star nature can express itself. Temple means well-placed and strong, fallen means displaced and hard to express, but brightness is not good or bad in itself.
cnDesc: 庙旺落陷是星曜在不同地支的亮度状态，决定这股星性能不能舒展；庙旺是星得地、力量足，落陷是星失地、难发挥，但亮度不是吉凶本身。

cnTitle: 空宫借星详解：本宫无主星，借对宫的星来安
enTitle: Empty Palaces Borrowing a Star: A Detailed Guide
enDesc: A palace with no major star is empty, not empty and hopeless; borrow the opposite star and read it with the triple-direction. After borrowing, how this palace expresses is set by both the opposite star nature and the home palace environment.
cnDesc: 本宫无主星叫空宫，不是「空了没戏」，而是借对宫主星来安，再合三方四正一起读；借星后这宫的表现方式，由对宫星性和本宫环境共同决定。

cnTitle: 飞宫三段论：立太极、找四化、看落点因果
enTitle: The Three-Step Flying-Palace Method for Beginners
enDesc: The three-step method breaks palace-stem flights into three: first set Tai Ji (which palace you speak from), then find that palace stem transformations, finally read the cause and effect of the landing palaces. Following these three steps keeps flying stars orderly.
cnDesc: 飞宫三段论把宫干飞化拆成三步：先立太极（站在哪个宫说话）、再找该宫干四化、最后看落点宫位的因果；新手按这三步走，飞星就不会乱。

cnTitle: 本宫飞出、他宫飞入：主动对外与外部对我的双向读法
enTitle: Flying Out vs Flying In: A Two-Way Reading
enDesc: Flying out of the home palace is what you actively do outward, the cause; flying in from other palaces is external influence on you, the effect. Read both directions to know how much is your initiative and how much is external push.
cnDesc: 本宫飞出（化出）是我主动对外做的事、为因；他宫飞入（化入）是外部宫位对我的影响、为果；双向都看，才知道一件事里我主动几分、外部推几分。

cnTitle: 看盘顺序怎么安排：固定六步，不乱不跳
enTitle: How to Arrange the Order of Reading a Chart
enDesc: Reading a chart has a fixed order: Life Palace sets the tone, triple-direction shows structure, transformations show energy, Body Palace shows later direction, decade shows the stage, year shows the current year. Following the order keeps you from jumping around.
cnDesc: 看盘有固定顺序：命宫定底色→三方四正看结构→四化看能量→身宫看后天→大限看阶段→流年看当年；按顺序走，才不会东一榔头西一棒子。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数排盘步骤：从出生时辰到完整命盘
enTitle: Steps to Build a Zi Wei Dou Shu Chart
enDesc: Building a chart has five steps: set birth time and Life/Body Palaces, place the fourteen major stars, place assistant and malefic stars, set natal transformations, and check empty palaces. Modern software does this, but knowing the steps lets you understand where the chart comes from.
cnDesc: 排盘分五步：定出生时辰与命宫身宫→安十四主星→安辅星煞星→定生年四化→检查空宫借星；现代用软件排盘，但懂步骤才读得懂盘怎么来的。

cnTitle: 天干地支基础：排盘与飞化的坐标系统
enTitle: Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches: The Coordinate System
enDesc: The ten heavenly stems and twelve earthly branches are the coordinates of Zi Wei Dou Shu: branches set the twelve palaces, stems set palace stems and activate transformations. Understand stems and branches first, then chart building and palace-stem flights.
cnDesc: 十天干、十二地支是紫微斗数的坐标：地支定十二宫位置，天干定宫干、引动四化飞星；先懂干支，才读得懂排盘和宫干飞化。

cnTitle: 真太阳时怎么看：出生地经度对时辰的修正
enTitle: How to Read True Solar Time in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: Clock time is unified zone time; true solar time corrects by birth-place longitude, especially at shichen boundaries. If born near a boundary, without correction the Life Palace may be wrong; this is the first verification.
cnDesc: 钟表时是统一时区时间，真太阳时据出生地经度修正，时辰交界尤其要算；若出生在时辰交界前后，不修正可能排错命宫，这是排盘第一道核验。

cnTitle: 身宫怎么看：后天用力的方向，与命宫对读
enTitle: How to Read the Body Palace: The Direction of Later Effort
enDesc: The Body Palace holds the direction and focus of later effort, the Life Palace holds the innate tone. Whichever palace the Body Palace lands in is where later effort goes; reading both shows a person direction.
cnDesc: 身宫写一个人后天的用力方向与发展重心，命宫写先天底色；身宫落在哪个宫，后天就往哪个领域使劲，命身对读才看得到一个人的走向。

cnTitle: 禄为因、忌为果：四化里的因果链怎么读
enTitle: Lu as Cause and Ji as Effect: Reading the Cause-Effect Chain
enDesc: Hua Lu governs investment and opportunity, the cause; Hua Ji governs attachment and result, the effect. Tracing from Lu to Ji shows where investment finally returns or stalls; this is the core of reading cause and effect.
cnDesc: 化禄主投入、机缘，是一件事的因；化忌主牵挂、结果，是一件事的果；从禄追到忌，看投入最终回报在哪、卡在哪，这是飞星读因果的核心。

cnTitle: 自化权怎么看：主动掌控的劲，防过刚独断
enTitle: How to Read the Self-Transforming Hua Quan
enDesc: When a palace stem makes its own star transform to Quan, it is the energy of actively wanting control and decisions, favoring leadership, entrepreneurship and responsibility. Unlike a natal Quan that is innate, guard being too rigid, dictatorial and deaf to others.
cnDesc: 本宫宫干使本宫星自化权，是自己主动要掌控、要拍板的劲，利带队、创业、专业负责；与生年权的「天生掌控」不同，要防过刚、独断、听不进人。

cnTitle: 飞化与生年四化区别：先天静态与后天动态两层
enTitle: Flying vs Natal Transformations: Two Layers
enDesc: Natal transformations are set by the birth-year stem, the innate static energy tone; palace-stem flights are activated by each palace stem, the later dynamic cause-effect actions. Read the two layers separately, not confusing innate with self-made.
cnDesc: 生年四化由出生年天干定，是先天静态的能量底色；宫干飞化由各宫天干引动，是后天动态的因果动作；两层分开读，才不会把「天生的」和「自己做的」混为一谈。

cnTitle: 禄忌冲宫怎么看：投入与卡点在一条线上拉扯
enTitle: How to Read Lu and Ji Clashing Across Opposite Palaces
enDesc: When Lu and Ji guard opposite palaces and clash, the investment direction and sticking-point direction pull along one straight line. Lu gives resources and Ji gives attachment; both are wanted yet restrain each other, and the stronger side leads.
cnDesc: 化禄与化忌分守对宫相冲，是投入的方向和卡点的方向在一条直线上拉扯；禄给资源、忌给牵挂，两头都想要又互相牵制，要看哪头力量强。

cnTitle: 紫府同宫格：帝星与财库同守寅申，须百官拱照
enTitle: The Zi Wei and Tian Fu Same-Palace Pattern
enDesc: When Zi Wei and Tian Fu guard the Life Palace in Yin or Shen, the emperor star and treasury share a palace, bringing gravitas, leadership and wealth bonds. The pattern needs Zuo You Kui Yue and other auspicious stars around with no malefic break, or it becomes aloof or toilsome.
cnDesc: 紫微天府在寅、申守命，帝星与财库同宫，主厚重、领导力与财缘；成格须左右魁钺等吉星拱照、无煞冲破，否则只是孤高或劳碌。

cnTitle: 雄宿干元格：廉贞七杀同未，阴火炼阴金
enTitle: The Xiong Su Gan Yuan Pattern: Lian Zhen and Qi Sha
enDesc: When Lian Zhen and Qi Sha share the Wei palace guarding life, yin fire tempers yin metal, bringing professional standing, martial distinction and resolute strategy. The pattern forms with Lu Quan Ke and no malefic Ji; it most fears Huo Xing conjunct breaking it (misregulated furnace).
cnDesc: 廉贞七杀在未宫同度守命，阴火锻炼阴金，主专业立身、武职功名、刚毅有谋；成格见禄权科、无煞忌，最怕火星同宫破格（火候失调）。

cnTitle: 马头带箭格：擎羊在午守命，刚烈立功名
enTitle: The Horse Head Bearing an Arrow Pattern
enDesc: When Qing Yang guards life in the Wu palace (or Tan Lang with Qing Yang in Wu), like a horse head bearing an arrow, it brings fierceness, bravery and distinction amid hardship. The pattern favors martial and pioneering work; guard injury, disaster and excess rigidity, needing auspicious stars to temper.
cnDesc: 擎羊在午宫守命（或贪狼与擎羊同午），如马头带箭，主刚烈、勇猛、能在艰难中立功名；成格利武职开拓，防刑伤、灾祸与过刚，须吉星调和。

cnTitle: 陌中隐玉格：巨门在子午守命，口舌化为思辨
enTitle: The Jade Hidden in the Rough Pattern: Ju Men at Zi Wu
enDesc: When Ju Men guards life at Zi or Wu with auspicious stars, like uncut jade hidden in stone, it brings critical thought, expression and research ability, a late bloomer. The speech star with auspicious transformations becomes persuasiveness; with malefics it still brings disputes.
cnDesc: 巨门星在子、午守命、见吉星，如璞玉藏在石中，主思辨、表达、研究能力，大器晚成；口舌星得吉化转为说服力，逢煞忌则仍主是非。

cnTitle: 英星入庙格：破军在子守命庙旺，变革星得地
enTitle: The Hero Star in the Temple Pattern: Po Jun at Zi
enDesc: When Po Jun guards life in the Zi palace at temple, the transformation star is well-placed, bringing pioneering, breaking the old to establish the new and opening new situations. The pattern favors expansion; guard isolation, drifting and thin family bonds, needing auspicious tempering.
cnDesc: 破军星在子宫守命、入庙，变革星得地，主开创、破旧立新、能打新局面；成格利开拓事业，防孤克、漂泊与六亲缘薄，须吉星调和。

cnTitle: 火贪格：贪狼火星同宫，主横发、明发
enTitle: The Huo Xing and Tan Lang Pattern: Sudden Open Gain
enDesc: When Tan Lang and Huo Xing share a palace at brightness, it brings sudden gain and opportunity erupting openly, known to all. The pattern favors seizing a trend to rise fast; it most fears Qing Yang or Tuo Luo conjunct breaking it, and sudden gain must guard sudden loss.
cnDesc: 贪狼与火星同宫、在庙旺之地，主横发、机遇爆发，明发众人皆知；成格利抓住风口快速崛起，最怕擎羊陀罗同宫破格，横发也要防横破。

cnTitle: 铃贪格：贪狼铃星同宫，主暗发、低调暴富
enTitle: The Ling Xing and Tan Lang Pattern: Quiet Hidden Gain
enDesc: When Tan Lang and Ling Xing share a palace, Ling Xing is yin fire governing patient planning, bringing quiet gain and low-key accumulation into wealth others do not notice. The pattern fears malefic breaks, and hidden gain must also guard being unkeepable.
cnDesc: 贪狼与铃星同宫，铃星为阴火、主沉淀谋划，主暗发、低调积累后暴富，旁人不易察觉；成格怕煞破，暗发同样要防守不住。

cnTitle: 昌曲同宫：文才出众，也要防有文无行
enTitle: Wen Chang and Wen Qu in the Same Palace
enDesc: When Wen Chang and Wen Qu share a palace guarding life, it brings literary and verbal talent, exam fortune and artistic sensitivity, favoring education, writing, scholarship and creativity. The pattern needs auspicious transformations; guard having letters without substance, self-admiring charm or document errors.
cnDesc: 文昌文曲同宫守命，主文才、口才、考试运与艺术感受力，利文教、写作、学术与创意；成格须吉化配合，防有文无实、风流自赏或文书出错。

cnTitle: 太阳星总论：主贵、主外放、主名声
enTitle: The Sun Star Overview: Distinction, Outwardness and Reputation
enDesc: The Sun star governs distinction, outwardness, reputation and light. At brightness it favors public stages, public service, sales and leadership; fallen, guard toil, empty name and worry. Its brightness varies greatly by palace, which sets how the outward energy expresses.
cnDesc: 太阳星主贵、主外放、主名声与光明，庙旺利公开舞台、公职、业务与领导，落陷防劳碌、虚名与操心；太阳的亮度随宫位变化大，落宫决定这股外放劲怎么表现。

cnTitle: 天同星总论：主福、主温和、主享受
enTitle: The Tian Tong Star Overview: Blessing, Gentleness and Enjoyment
enDesc: Tian Tong governs blessing, gentleness, enjoyment and emotion. With auspicious stars it enjoys fortune and good relationships, favoring service and education; with malefics, guard laziness, moodiness and spending through emotion. It gives a blessing tone, materializing through effort and discipline.
cnDesc: 天同星主福、主温和、主享受与情绪，逢吉星享福、人缘好、利服务文教，逢煞忌防懒散、情绪化与因情耗财；天同给的是福气底色，兑现要看努力和约束。

cnTitle: 红鸾天喜区别：一主婚恋、一主喜庆，二星永远相对
enTitle: Hong Luan vs Tian Xi: Romance and Celebration Stars
enDesc: Hong Luan governs romance, marriage movement and relationship joy; Tian Xi governs celebration, children and relationships. The two always sit six positions apart in opposition. When activated, they often correspond to marriage or birth, but still read natal Spouse and Children Palaces.
cnDesc: 红鸾主婚恋、动婚、感情喜事，天喜主喜庆、添丁、人缘，二星在盘上永远相隔六位相对；逢红鸾天喜引动，多应婚恋生育，但仍要看本命夫妻子女宫配合。

cnTitle: 魁钺夹命：天魁天钺在左右，贵人贴身
enTitle: Kui Yue Flanking the Life Palace: Close Mentors
enDesc: Tian Kui (yang mentor) and Tian Yue (yin mentor) guard the two flanking palaces around Life, bringing close mentors and help in need. The pattern needs no malefic break; mentors help the prepared, and one own ability remains the root.
cnDesc: 天魁（阳贵人）、天钺（阴贵人）分守命宫左右夹宫，主贵人贴身、逢难得助；成格须无煞冲破，贵人帮的是有准备的人，自身实力仍是根本。

cnTitle: 流年身宫怎么看：该年后天重心在哪
enTitle: How to Read the Annual Body Palace
enDesc: The annual Body Palace sets the later effort direction and focus of the year, read with the annual Life Palace (the year tone). Whichever area it lands in is where the year effort goes; it only adjusts one year.
cnDesc: 流年身宫定这一年后天用力的方向与重心，与流年命宫（该年基调）对读；流年身宫落哪个领域，这一年就往哪使劲，只主一年加减。

cnTitle: 大限身宫怎么看：这十年后天重心在哪
enTitle: How to Read the Decade Body Palace
enDesc: The decade Body Palace sets the later effort direction and focus of ten years, read with the decade Life Palace (ten-year tone). Whichever area it lands in is where the decade deepens; it governs the ten-year direction.
cnDesc: 大限身宫定这十年后天用力方向与重心，与大限命宫（十年基调）对读；大限身宫落哪个领域，这十年就往哪深耕，主管十年走向。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数盘准不准：准的是倾向，不是百分百剧本
enTitle: Is a Zi Wei Chart Accurate? Tendencies, Not a Script
enDesc: A chart is accurate about temperament tendencies and probability ranges, not a precise script of every event. Accuracy also depends on reading skill, correct birth information and how you use it; read right and used well, the chart feels accurate.
cnDesc: 命盘准的是性格倾向与概率区间，不是每件事的精确剧本；准不准还看读盘水平、出生信息准不准、以及你怎么用，读得对、用得好，盘就「准」。

cnTitle: 可以自己看盘吗：学方法、照自己，重大决策仍问专业
enTitle: Can You Read Your Own Chart? Learn Method, Seek Pros for Big Decisions
enDesc: You can absolutely read your own chart by learning basic palaces, stars and transformations to reflect on your temperament and choices. But self-reading carries subjectivity; major health, legal and financial decisions still defer to professionals and proper channels.
cnDesc: 完全可以自己看盘，学基础的宫星四化方法、拿盘反思自己的性格与选择；但自己看容易带主观，重大健康、法律、财务决策仍以专业人士和正规途径为准。

cnTitle: 考试季怎么看：文昌化科与流年节奏，努力仍是主体
enTitle: How to Read Exam Season: Wen Chang, Hua Ke and Timing
enDesc: Exam fortune reads the Career Palace, Wen Chang Wen Qu and whether the year has Hua Ke activation; favorable timing runs smoother. But the chart only gives state and timing; review, method and performance are the substance, and timing without effort is useless.
cnDesc: 考试运看官禄宫、文昌文曲与流年有没有化科引动，利考试的年份节奏更顺；但盘只给状态和节奏，复习、方法和临场发挥才是主体，不努力光看流年没用。

cnTitle: 买房选房怎么看：田宅宫看缘分，合同渠道是底线
enTitle: How to Read Buying and Choosing a Home
enDesc: The Property Palace reads real-estate bonds and home timing, combined with Wealth for purchasing power. But buying ultimately relies on reality: budget, location, loans, proper contracts and developer qualifications; astrology only gives timing, not investment advice.
cnDesc: 田宅宫看不动产缘分与家庭节奏，结合财帛判断购买力；但买房最终靠现实：预算、地段、贷款、正规合同与开发商资质，命理只给节奏参考，不构成投资建议。

cnTitle: 出差外派怎么看：迁移宫看在外际遇，逢禄马利外出
enTitle: How to Read Business Trips and Out-of-Town Assignments
enDesc: The Travel Palace reads your state and encounters away; with Tian Ma and Hua Lu activation, trips and assignments are favored with gain through movement. With malefics, guard obstacles, exhaustion and disputes away; travel outcomes still combine natal Travel trines.
cnDesc: 迁移宫看在外的状态与际遇，逢天马、化禄引动利出差外派、动中求财；逢煞忌防在外阻滞、劳损和口舌，外出的顺逆仍要合本命迁移三方看。

cnTitle: 合作签约怎么看：交友官禄看合作，书面合同是底线
enTitle: How to Read Cooperation and Signing Contracts
enDesc: Cooperation reads the Friends and Career Palaces for division and bonds. But signing ultimately relies on written contracts, term review and professional lawyers; astrology only hints at cooperation timing, and verbal promises do not count.
cnDesc: 合作看交友宫与官禄宫的配合，看双方分工与缘分；但签约最终靠书面合同、条款审核和专业律师，命理只提示合作节奏，口头承诺不作数。

cnTitle: 养老规划怎么看：田宅福德财帛看节奏，正规产品为准
enTitle: How to Read Retirement Planning
enDesc: Retirement reads Property (housing), Karma (spirit) and Wealth (pension) together with decade timing. But planning ultimately relies on proper financial products, social security, contracts and licensed institutions; astrology only gives direction, not investment advice.
cnDesc: 养老看田宅（居住）、福德（精神）、财帛（养老金）三宫配合与大限节奏；但规划最终靠正规金融产品、社保、合同和持牌机构，命理只给方向，不构成投资建议。

cnTitle: 离婚财产怎么看：夫妻财帛田宅看分割，以律师法院为准
enTitle: How to Read Divorce Property Division
enDesc: The Spouse, Wealth and Property Palaces can show tendencies and entanglement in division. But divorce property must follow marriage law, professional lawyers, court judgments and written agreements; astrology only hints at relationship and property timing, not legal basis.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫与财帛、田宅宫可看财产分割的倾向与纠葛；但离婚财产分割必须以婚姻法、专业律师、法院判决和书面协议为准，命理只提示关系与财产的节奏，不作法律依据。

cnTitle: 左右夹命：左辅右弼在左右，助力贴身
enTitle: Zuo Fu and You Bi Flanking the Life Palace
enDesc: Zuo Fu and You Bi guard the two flanking palaces around Life, bringing close support and assistance in doing. The pattern needs no malefic break; assistant stars help those willing to act, and the self remains the backbone.
cnDesc: 左辅、右弼分守命宫左右夹宫，主助力贴身、有人辅佐、做事有人帮；成格须无煞冲破，辅星帮的是肯做事的人，自身仍是主心骨。

cnTitle: 命身同宫怎么看：先天后天合一，性格与走向一致
enTitle: Life and Body Palaces in the Same Position
enDesc: When Life and Body Palaces land in the same position, innate temperament and later direction align, bringing development with nature, consistency and less inner friction. But it also means the theme concentrates there, success and failure both landing in it; read the star combination and trines.
cnDesc: 命宫身宫落在同一宫，先天性格与后天方向合一，主顺性发展、言行一致、少内耗；但同宫也意味着这一领域主题集中，成败都落在这，要看星曜组合和三方。
